items_stock_accounts.name: items_stock_accounts
items_stock_accounts.value: "items"."kind" <> 'stock' or ("items"."inventory_account_id" is not null and "items"."expense_account_id" is not null)

journal_entries_posted_numbered.name: journal_entries_posted_numbered
journal_entries_posted_numbered.value: "journal_entries"."status" = 'draft' or ("journal_entries"."entry_number" is not null and "journal_entries"."period_id" is not null and "journal_entries"."posted_at" is not null)
